prompt:
Game map background for a 2D top-down RPG, 1536x1024 landscape (3:2), filling the whole frame edge to edge, no border.

CAMERA: high-angle bird's-eye view looking down at about 50 degrees, orthographic-looking like a classic JRPG / Stardew-style town map: NO vanishing point, NO perspective convergence, all vertical building edges parallel and pointing straight up the image, ground plane seen almost from above. Building fronts are visible as short facades along the top and side edges; we see their roofs foreshortened. Consistent scale: a doorway is about 60 px wide and 100 px tall, a person would be about 90 px tall (but draw NO people).

STYLE: hand-painted cartoon illustration in exactly the painting style of the attached reference map (clean dark ink outlines on every shape, soft painterly cel shading, natural proportions, rich but slightly muted colours, no chibi, no pixel art, no 3D render, no photo). Mood and palette from the attached stage backdrop: Cyberpunk underground city in the year 2086, night-blue shadows, rusty metal, corrugated sheet metal, cables, steam, wet ground with reflections, neon light in hot pink, cyan and violet, warm yellow window light as accent. Readable game art: the walkable ground is large, flat, clearly lit and uncluttered; props sit at the edges; strong value contrast between floor (walkable) and walls/props (blocking).

The attached images are references for painting style, camera angle, scale and colour ONLY. Do not copy their buildings or layout and do not draw any characters.

STRICT: no people, no figures, no animals, no silhouettes of persons, no readable text, no letters, no numbers, no logos, no watermarks, no signature, no frame, no UI.

LOCATION: Follow the layout of the attached grey blockout sketch: light = walkable ground, dark = buildings/blocking, cyan = exits. The last attached image is only the floor-plan sketch, not its look. "Bahnhof Mitte", a big shabby underground metro station hall in the slums, seen from above, lit by flickering fluorescent tubes and neon (an underground space: no sky, a dark tiled ceiling edge is only hinted at the very top). The large walkable area is the wide station concourse of worn square floor tiles (dirty cream and teal tiles, wet patches mirroring neon) filling the whole upper-middle of the image from the left edge to the right edge, continuing down along the LEFT third of the image to the bottom edge; three square tiled pillars stand in the concourse.
TOP EDGE, the back wall of the hall made of cracked white and teal tiles with peeling torn poster ads (pictures only, no text), from left to right: an internet café front with a glass door and a wide window full of flickering blue and green monitor screens and a neon computer-mouse symbol; an old photo booth with a red curtain and a flash lamp; in the TOP CENTER the GRAND STAIRCASE - the most eye-catching spot: a wide stone staircase leading straight up and out of the image at the top edge, flanked by brass railings, with a white-and-blue corporate security checkpoint at its foot (two sleek turnstile gates and a small glass guard booth with a cold white lamp); right of the stairs a hover-taxi stand: a small marked landing bay with yellow chevrons under a round vertical light shaft, a taxi sign as a symbol only (a little flying car icon); then a lost-and-found counter: a service window with a half-open rolling shutter, shelves of odd forgotten things (umbrellas, a tuba, a robot arm) visible behind it, and a narrow door; in the TOP-RIGHT CORNER the signal box: a raised glass control booth with blinking red and green track-signal panels and many round clocks.
Along the walls: two ticket vending machines glowing cyan, a newspaper kiosk booth with a striped awning and stacks of papers and snacks against the LEFT wall, a wooden crate with an open guitar case on it (street musician corner, no musician), worn benches, a broken vending machine.
MIDDLE RIGHT: the concourse ends in a long platform with a bright YELLOW safety edge line; below it the sunken track trench with two rails, gravel and puddles, and a dented, graffiti-covered metro train with sliding doors waiting in the trench (train runs horizontally across the image from the right edge, its front ends at buffer stops near the left third).
LOWER RIGHT: a narrow island platform (also with yellow edges on both sides) running horizontally, with a small glass waiting shelter with a bench in its middle; below it a second track trench where an old abandoned rusty metro car stands on a dead siding, covered in graffiti shapes and stickers, one sliding door forced half open facing the island platform, faint candle-yellow light inside.
Track trenches end at the left at red-and-white buffer stops; the left part of the concourse connects to both platforms.
Small things at the edges: litter bins, a cleaning robot parked at a wall, pigeon spikes, steam from a floor grate, thin cables drawn thin so they don't hide the floor, puddles on the tiles.
EXITS clearly readable at the image edges: TOP edge (north) center - the grand staircase going up out of the image; RIGHT edge (east) - at the end of the upper platform a narrow steel maintenance catwalk with a cyan safety railing leads into a dark arched track tunnel; BOTTOM edge (south) on the left - a narrower staircase going up out of the image with a glowing cyan railing and a round metro emblem (no letters) toward the street.
Light: underground night, cold fluorescent light, neon in hot pink, cyan and violet, warm yellow accents from the kiosk and the waiting shelter.
